shared_elements: framing border along the edge of the field
justification: Both surfaces show standing human figures in profile holding upright elongated implements, and both have a border framing the field, but these are near-universal conventions. A depicts a small register of three crude stick-like warriors above a large horned quadruped with a rider, while B is a single tall, elaborately costumed personage flanked by columns of repeated glyph-like signs — different subjects, different compositional schemes, and utterly different levels of ornamental detail.
